detail: Function `public.clear_must_set_password()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/clear_must_set_password`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
